method: Node WASM output equivalence and C++ call durations, not a browser/FPS benchmark. Fresh cube per trial; alternate before/after call order across trials. First trial includes cold heap growth; later trials reuse warm modules. Calls include subdivision, normals and render export; exclude JS upload/readback/renderer/history. Twelve exported buffers are byte-identical at every stage and floating outputs finite.
changes: Fuse face-normal computation with ordered vertex-normal accumulation; preserve floating accumulation and normalization math. Keep the independent vertex-normal API.
Render export reads flat arrays by reference, reserves triangle output and reuses unique-edge direction/use counts/weights instead of copying arrays and building three ordered maps.
Remove the redundant post-smooth normal recomputation; keep the empty-mesh behavior and original ABI iteration clamp.

Migrate position lookup, directed edge vectors, face-local principal curvature and variable offsets to flat storage. Lookup preserves precision-six insertion, requested query precision, signed zero and last duplicate. Existing topology identity remains authoritative without creating topology.
topologyStatus: The migrated geometry paths do not create halfedges. Ordered vertex rings/incidence, vertex curvature/areas, edge face/boundary/dihedral queries, face adjacency, explicit halfedge APIs and local topology edits retain the lazy backend. Replacing ordered incidence and all SDK topology use remains incomplete; APIs and ID semantics are preserved.
validation: Final isolated native Release build and focused zspace.smoke CTest passed. Native before/after cube 1–8, batch 8, curvature and 500000-quad geometry/normal/connectivity digests match; edge-vector/face-curvature/variable-offset digests match.

Focused tests verify lookup precision/duplicate/signed-zero behavior, mutation and copy cache invalidation, preserved edge direction/offset order, no topology materialization for migrated geometry, and explicit halfedge materialization.

Final WASM build passed. Three alternating-order cube trials through eight divisions: twelve exported buffers byte-identical at all 27 stages. Mixed colored/custom-weight faces, nonmanifold faces, repeated-corner/self-edge faces, and three exact 500000-quad grid trials also match byte-for-byte; all exported floats finite.
Pre-existing typed-upload and planarity buffer exports are preserved; the bridge diff against the saved dirty source is confined to render export and normal recomputation.
Verified runtime installed in viewer; prior runtime backed up under wasm/tmp/render-export-install-before. npm run build passed after installation. No UI/sketch/API changes, commit or push.
limitations: Three trials are exploratory. Timed WASM calls include subdivision, final normals and render export. They exclude JS upload/readback, history, renderer and GPU; end-to-end 500000-face viewer responsiveness remains unverified.
Caching two integers per unique edge adds flat-storage memory/work. Native kernel-only grid timing is included separately; bridge improvements do not imply every native workload improves.

Native verification used the isolated configuration with optional TinyUSDZ disabled after the earlier default-build dependency failure. Separate OpenUSD/CMake/codec changes appeared during this work and were left untouched. The current default build, USD IO and native OpenGL runtime are not verified by this milestone.

installation.viewerBuild: npm run build passed (tsc --noEmit and vite build)
